title: Jubilant Charred German Sausage Skewers
description: A kosher-friendly German dish featuring charred sausage and rice krispies, served with a side of ferment-jang sauce, grilled to perfection on a robata-grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the German sausage, onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms onto skewers.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the sausage is charred and cooked through.
While the skewers are grilling, mix the ferment-jang sauce with 1 tablespoon of water.
Once the skewers are done, brush them with the ferment-jang sauce mixture.
Sprinkle the rice krispies over the skewers and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional rice krispies and ferment-jang sauce, if desired.
